question: Which eight qualities of the self are traditionally recognized here?
premises: Compassion, forbearance, and non-envy are listed as qualities.
Purity, good conduct, and auspiciousness are listed as qualities.
Non-miserliness and non-desire complete the set of eight.
inference: These eight virtues together constitute the traditional set of qualities of the self.
uncertainties: The exact grouping of the paired compounds may vary in interpretation.
plain_english: Compassion, forbearance, non-envy, purity, good conduct, auspiciousness, non-miserliness, and non-desire are remembered as this eightfold set of qualities of the self.
